Objective / Behavior: Stop weather, grit, water, and gear before they enter the home
Benefit / Effect: Starting Room; unlock six Mudroom zones
Canonical text: A mudroom succeeds by what it stops, not by how much it stores.

Objective / Behavior: Give each person a named vertical column at their own reach
Benefit / Effect: Prevents coats and bags from migrating to the floor
Canonical text: Fix the wall before the floor: one coat, one bag, one hat per person.

Objective / Behavior: Keep the seat clear for changing footwear and short-term outbound items
Canonical text: The bench is for sitting, not permanent storage.

Objective / Behavior: Contain two current-season pairs per person and drain wet footwear
Benefit / Effect: Stops grit and water at the threshold
Canonical text: Store daily pairs low, wet pairs on the lipped tray, and off-season pairs elsewhere.

Objective / Behavior: Keep the walking kit, paw towel, bowls, and treatments in safe locations
Benefit / Effect: Supports fast departures and clean returns
Canonical text: The walking kit stays together; food belongs where the animal is fed.

Objective / Behavior: Keep only current-season gloves, hats, umbrellas, and weather items accessible
Canonical text: Current-season gear stays open and reachable; off-season gear is clean, dry, dated, and stored high.

Objective / Behavior: Store cleaning tools at the point of mess without leaving them on the floor
Benefit / Effect: Speeds cleanup and removes trip hazards
Canonical text: Nothing stands on the floor, nothing returns wet, and every bottle stays labeled.

Objective / Behavior: Scrape outside, absorb inside, and catch drips where footwear actually comes off
Benefit / Effect: Blocks grit and invisible moisture film
Canonical text: A stiff mat, absorbent mat, and lipped tray do more than repeated mopping.

Objective / Behavior: Use open, visible containers for daily items
Canonical text: Daily-use storage stays open; lids are reserved for clean, dry off-season gear.

Objective / Behavior: Assign each person an owned vertical strip of hooks, bins, and floor space

Objective / Behavior: Give damp coats, towels, umbrellas, and boots a place to dry fully
Benefit / Effect: Prevents musty gear and moisture damage
Canonical text: Wet gear never disappears into a closed box or returns to storage damp.

Objective / Behavior: Hold only items leaving the house tomorrow
Benefit / Effect: Prevents the bench from becoming a holding bay
Canonical text: The outbound basket is temporary flow, not permanent storage.

Objective / Behavior: Keep the walking strip beneath hooks and beside the bench completely clear
Canonical text: The floor strip tells the truth: when the wall fills, the floor follows.

Objective / Behavior: Reduce excess coats, bags, hats, and scarves
Canonical text: Every overloaded hook pushes the next item onto the floor.

Objective / Behavior: Separate mixed family belongings into owned spaces
Canonical text: When everyone shares every hook, no one owns the result.
